recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-file browser Canvas survival avoider titled “Sheriff Skibidi: Dust Jail Drift.” Preserve the original mechanics exactly: pointer/touch target steering with eased movement, time-based score, score-driven spawn difficulty, hazards spawning from screen edges, circular collision defeat, and restart. Rebuild all presentation around this prompt: Create a deterministic creative remix in a brainrot style, centered on a cowboy outlaw, but make it absurd. Preserve the core playable mechanic loop while rebuilding the theme, identity, surface art, world language, and presentation around this new premise.

Use procedural browser-native art: a cowboy outlaw head with hat and bandana as the player, spiky BONK tumbleweeds as hazards, animated desert background with cacti, dust ribbons, hot sun, meme poster text, Bangers title type, Press Start 2P HUD, desert catalog audio, and compact feedback GIF overlays. Do not add weapons, collectibles, health, or new rules.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Single-screen canvas survival avoider.
- objective: Keep the player avatar away from incoming hazards for as long as possible.
- input model: Mouse movement and touch drag update a target position; the avatar eases toward that target.
- core loop: Start run, steer the avatar, hazards spawn from screen edges and move across the arena, time score rises, difficulty slowly increases, collision ends the run, restart resets state.
- fail/friction state: Circular contact with a pulsing hazard triggers game over and displays final survival score.

## Protected mechanics
- Pointer/touch steering target and 0.15 easing movement.
- Time-based score increment of ten points per second.
- Difficulty multiplier derived from score and used to shorten spawn interval and increase enemy speed.
- Edge-spawned hazards with random side, direction, speed, radius, and pulsing collision size.
- Collision defeat using player radius plus hazard radius with a small forgiveness offset.
- Menu, play, game-over, and restart state flow.

## Remixed target
Sheriff Skibidi: Dust Jail Drift reframes the same survival avoider as an absurd cowboy outlaw brainrot chase. The player is a floating outlaw sheriff head/hat drifting through a meme desert while cursed BONK tumbleweeds stampede from the edges. The score is a Yeehaw Streak, warning feedback is TOO CLOSE, and failure is getting sent to Dust Jail. Presentation changes are procedural Canvas/CSS art and catalog-backed media only; mechanics stay intact.
